copy.headline: Northwest ISD approves revised high school boundaries after parents speak out
copy.caption:
Several neighborhoods will remain zoned for their current schools, but officials warn another rezoning may be needed in two years. Northwest ISD trustees may have to redraw high school attendance boundaries as soon as next year, despite having just approved a new map.

The possibility comes after trustees agreed Nov. 9, in response to community concerns, to keep hundreds of students in their current attendance zones who otherwise would have changed schools.
